summary: This topic details the process of adding new vehicles (buses) to the ERP system, including mandatory and optional information such as RC number, seating capacity, and insurance details. It also covers updating existing vehicle information.
steps: Optionally, upload corresponding documents like pollution certificate, fitness certificate, road permit, or road tax.
To update an existing vehicle, select the vehicle and click 'Update Detail'.
business_rules: RC number, Seating Capacity, and Insurance Date are mandatory fields when adding a new vehicle.
important_notes: GPS ID is used for GPS tracking functionality.
Users can add any number of vehicles.
Existing vehicle details can be updated at any time.
